them.zh: Spec Kit 与智能体做的

steps.en: Install the CLI and scaffold the project for your agent
steps.zh: 装好 CLI，为你的智能体初始化项目

steps.en: Writes the spec/plan/tasks templates, scripts and /speckit-* skills into the project
steps.zh: 把 spec、方案、任务模板、脚本和 /speckit-* 技能写进项目

steps.en: In the agent chat, describe what to build and why
steps.zh: 在智能体对话里说清要做什么、为什么

steps.en: Agent fills the template into specs/NNN-feature/spec.md
steps.zh: 智能体按模板写出 specs/NNN-功能/spec.md

steps.en: Review the spec, then give the tech stack
steps.zh: 审过 spec，再给出技术栈

steps.en: Writes a technical plan and an ordered task list
steps.zh: 写出技术方案和有顺序的任务清单

steps.en: Start the build and the spec check
Builds task by task; converge adds unbuilt work as tasks until Converged
steps.zh: 逐个任务实现；converge 把没做完的追加成任务，直到 Converged

value.en: Every feature leaves a spec, plan and task list a reviewer can check the code against
value.zh: 每个功能都留下 spec、方案和任务清单，评审能拿它们对照代码

sources: https://github.com/github/spec-kit#get-started (uv tool install specify-cli; specify init my-project --integration copilot; /speckit-* are agent skills)
https://github.com/github/spec-kit/blob/main/templates/commands/converge.md (assess code vs spec/plan/tasks, append unbuilt work as new tasks)
